purpose: The single machine-readable record of the pinned toolchain, read by the doctor and bootstrap verbs of ./build.sh and ./build.ps1.

Authority: docs/technical/100-build-dependencies-and-release-operations.md § Toolchain pinning, which requires that a bootstrap command 'verifies/downloads approved public tools or prints exact manual installation instructions and checks hashes'.
Owned by the FND-002 integration owner. A tool is added here only with the dependency request recorded in doc 100 § Dependency policy.

dotnet_sdk.install_directory_reason: hostfxr's default probe path. Godot's GodotPlugins host resolves the runtime from there with no DOTNET_ROOT and no dotnet on PATH; a custom install directory breaks the headless game launch.

godot.unpinned_platform_policy: A platform with no recorded hash is reported by doctor as an explicit warning naming this file, never as a silent pass. Recording the Windows and macOS hashes is FND-002 follow-on work; doc 100 § Toolchain pinning requires the pin, and only linux-x64 has been bootstrapped so far.

godot_export_templates.deferred_reason: 1.2 GB. Needed only by the export and package verbs, whose owner is FND-006. doctor reports it as deferred until that package lands, and never fails on its absence.

optional_tools.name: blender
optional_tools.deferred_reason: doc 100 § Toolchain pinning requires the exact Blender major/minor/patch used by derivation scripts. No derivation script exists until AST-002, so the exact version is pinned by that package. doctor reports Blender as deferred, not missing.

optional_tools.name: pwsh
optional_tools.deferred_reason: build.ps1 is the Windows workflow wrapper. PowerShell is not required on Linux or macOS; when it is present, build/verify-wrapper-parity.sh proves wrapper parity by executing both wrappers instead of by comparing their sources.

optional_tools.name: xvfb-run
optional_tools.deferred_reason: --headless uses the dummy rendering driver and cannot capture a viewport, so the screenshot/render tier needs Xvfb plus a software Vulkan ICD. No screenshot verification exists until PRE-004.

required_commands.name: git
required_commands.reason: source revision identity in verb results and evidence bundles

required_commands.name: unzip
required_commands.reason: bootstrap extracts the pinned Godot archive

required_commands.name: curl
required_commands.reason: bootstrap downloads the pinned Godot archive and the .NET install script
